facts.business: Cyient DLM Limited is a design-led manufacturing company transitioning from a pure-play manufacturing partner to a specialised strategic partner, focusing on Aerospace & Defence, Medical, Industrial, and Automotive sectors with a global OEM customer base and an India-US hybrid manufacturing model.
key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant estimates and judgements
Inventory obsolescence assessment involves significant judgement and estimates
Impairment/fair valuation testing assumptions are highly judgmental and affected by future market and economic conditions
Concentration in Aerospace & Defence sector (52% exposure)
facts.related_party_note: Term loan from related party of Rs 497.81 million as at March 31, 2025 (nil as at March 31, 2026). Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Act.
